text: Every tutorial uses work repo, named title: lowercase, spaces non-alphanumeric characters replaced dashes (“Sampling Distributions” → sampling-distributions). title changes, update repo-name instruction, every prompt line, every /workspaces/<name> path, every URL (github.com/<user>/<name>, <user>.github.io/<name>/). change id:, directory name, chunk labels. title must never map codespace-starter.
